# Motor Fuel Prices – August 2026

BTS 26-65  
  
Today, the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) released monthly motor fuels prices for August 2026.

In August 2026, the average price for regular motor gasoline was $4.06 per gallon; up 3.2% from July 2026 and up 29.5% from August 2025. WASHINGTON, DC (August 27, 2026) – The national average for a gallon of regular gasoline is one cent lower than last week at $4.09, but there’s been little movement on the crude oil front. Due to continued volatility in the Strait of Hormuz, crude oil prices remain in the $80 per barrel range. For the first time ever, the national average in August has been above $4 per gallon every day. Gas prices have shown no signs of easing as the end of summer approaches, a time when drivers would normally begin to see some relief. Instead, prices have remained above $4, reaching record levels.
